title: ADR: move outbound connector auth (OAuth2 grants, app-credential exchange, request signing) into the open tier — the successor record #26702 and #26710 both wait on
body:
carries item 1 of #26702 and item 1 of #26710; #26702 keeps items 2–7, #26710 keeps items 2–4.

Split by the `domain:server` seat 3 (`session_01QSeKYmQXM3rHJcPnrEPk4B`), because both queued cards put the ADR first and the ADR is a governed surface outside the server lane (`docs/adr/**`, Tier H). ⛔ Not a claim. No `domain:*` label: triage sets lane, area and grade. Both parent cards go to `pm:blocked` with `Blocked-by:` this card.

## Maintainer rulings this record carries (verbatim, not translated, from #26702)

> OAuth 放开源层，先起草 ADR 修订

> 平台基于 better-auth ，怎么会有没有 oauth

> 创建issue 就行

And from #26710's filing: 「三条行动建议 立卡」 → 「建议 1+2立卡」 → 「3 不考虑」 (recommendation 2 = request signing).

## Work

1. A successor ADR in this repository that moves outbound connector auth into the open tier: OAuth2 (`authorization_code` + PKCE + refresh, `client_credentials`), the vendor app-credential exchange (Feishu / DingTalk / WeCom), and a `signed` request-signing kind with a closed scheme enum (#26710's proposed shape). One record decides all of it (#26710: "this card adds the signing decision to that record rather than opening a second one").
2. Status-line amendments to ADR-0015, ADR-0022, ADR-0023, ADR-0024 and ADR-0097 where they place OAuth2 in the enterprise tier (#26702 item 1). ADRs are append-only (AGENTS.md Prime Directive 13): dated amendment notes, not rewrites.
3. Per Prime Directive 13, the open/enterprise boundary half also owes a `cloud ADR-NNNN` record with a `## Provenance` pointer back here (#26702 item 1). That is a cloud-repository card; the drafting seat files it there.

## Decisions the ADR puts to the maintainer (from #26702)

- Connection ownership and execution identity: org-shared vs per-user connection, and whose grant a flow run uses (ADR-0073).
- Storage: reuse better-auth `account` storage and refresh, or a dedicated connection object (a linked `account` is also a sign-in method, which an integration grant must not become).
- First products for the first acceptance.
- From #26710: which signing schemes ship first; the secret is always a `credentialRef` (ADR-0097 §3).

## Governing text

- AGENTS.md Prime Directive 13: an accepted ADR binds until a superseding ADR says otherwise.
- `packages/spec/src/shared/connector-auth.zod.ts`: "OAuth2 is intentionally absent (enterprise tier, ADR-0015)." Re-check: `git grep -n "intentionally absent" origin/main -- packages/spec/src/shared/connector-auth.zod.ts`.
- ADR-0097: "The open tier deliberately omits OAuth2 from `ConnectorInstanceAuthSchema`". Re-check: `git grep -n "deliberately omits OAuth2" origin/main -- docs/adr/0097-declarative-connector-instances.md`.

## Done when

The successor ADR and the five amendment notes are merged by the maintainer (Tier H), with the decisions above answered in the record; #26702 and #26710 are then released from `pm:blocked` for their spec, runtime and console slices.

## Who acts

Per both parent cards: the `domain:skills` seat drafts, the maintainer lands. Triage confirms.
